method: scripts/qa/watch_container_mem.sh: /proc/meminfo 1 Hz (host used = MemTotal - MemAvailable), container main PID VmRSS 1 Hz, docker stats 5 s; AutoModel per-step 'mem' from logs/stdout.log
attribution_caveat: Peak coincides with step 0 (bao-backend). ~4 GB of the host-vs-RSS gap matches CUDA max_allocated at step 0 (UMA allocations are not in RSS); the rest is likely JIT compiler child processes (not in the main PID VmRSS, but in the container cgroup) plus CUDA context / caching-allocator reserved. Not yet verified: next run samples cgroup memory.current/peak and memory_reserved, and repeats with a warm Triton cache.
recommendation_for_estimator: ram_gb [7, 13]; keep >= 12.6 GB as STARTUP peak (cold JIT cache). Steady ~6.5 GB. Re-measure with warm Triton cache before lowering.
memory_peak_phase: startup: first forward/backward + Triton JIT compile (LoRA kernels + GatedDeltaNet), 09:30:54-09:33:45 UTC; AutoModel step-0 mem 8.14 GiB (~2x steady)
